about: Product images on the home page. Each entry is one framed image: the source file, the crop that proves the claim (in source pixels), an optional narrower crop for phones, and its words. To swap a design render for a live capture, replace the source file, update this entry (dimensions, crop, tag, alt) and run `node scripts/home-renders.mjs --src <folder with the source files>`. The page reads this file; nothing else needs to change.
